0022600211.text: The Knicks, now 5-4 and on a three-game win streak, host the 1-8 Milwaukee Bucks in New York's 10th game of 2026-27, with the Knicks 3-2 at home and sitting 3rd in the Atlantic, 2.5 games back. Josh Hart is out with an ankle injury for New York. The teams have not yet met this season, and the Knicks won the 2025-26 series 2-1, including a 127-98 regular-season win in Milwaukee on February 27, 2026.
